evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label, updates cryptographic primitives under src/crypto/, and integrates hardware SHA256 into libsecp256k1.
rationale: Plugging hardware-accelerated SHA256 into libsecp256k1 unlocks ARM and x86 SHA-NI instructions during signing and verification. This delivers meaningful performance gains for cryptographic primitives and cleans up ECC context management across the codebase.
